summary: Backend (10/10 pytest passing) and Frontend (all critical e2e flows verified) of QA Demo Store. Backend FastAPI mirror with /api/*.php routes works against MongoDB. Frontend login (success/invalid/locked), product list with 6 cards, sort (az/za/lohi/hilo), add/remove to cart, badge updates, product details, cart increment/remove, cart-empty state, checkout validation (empty fields shows 'Please fill in all fields'), order placement -> /order-confirmation/:id, cart cleared (qa_demo_cart removed), auth persistence across refresh, logout clears qa_demo_user, protected route redirect to /login - all verified PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking, low priority).
Order total trusts the client-supplied value; for a production e-commerce app the server should recompute total from items+products. OK for QA demo but worth noting.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router which still works in FastAPI but conventionally middleware is added before mounting routes.
seed_data_creation: None — backend seeds 3 users and 6 products automatically on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_qa_demo_api.py cover products list/by-id/404, users list (no password leak), login (success/locked/wrong-pwd/missing-body), and orders (create+increment, empty cart 400). Frontend product-sort uses values: az, za, lohi, hilo (NOT 'price-asc'). All data-testids match spec. The flow is solid; no flakiness observed beyond ordinary timing waits.
